config.name: market_size
config.description: The same task stream (300 tasks) served by markets of 10, 50, 100, 500 and 1000 synthetic agents. Arms differ in population, so they are paired by replication seed rather than by identical agents.
config.hypothesis: More competitors lower the average price paid and raise completion, with diminishing returns; concentration of wins (HHI) falls as the market grows.
